items.title: The Boox Palma 2 Pro finally got me to stop reading on my phone
items.author: Aisha Malik
items.content: <article>The $400 Boox Palma 2 Pro is a smartphone-sized e-reader designed for people who want to read books, articles, and documents on a small E Ink display. </article>

items.content: <article>At TechCrunch Disrupt last week, two founders and a VC discussed how to not just gain an early following but keep one. </article>

items.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
items.author: Julie Bort
items.content: <article>The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command. </article>

items.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 roundtables: Go deeper on the challenges founders are solving right now
items.author: TechCrunch Events
items.content: <article>TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 is coming to SoWa Power Station in Boston on November 4, bringing founders, investors, and operators together for a full day of candid conversations, practical sessions, live pitching, networking, and smaller roundtables built for deeper discussion. </article>

items.title: Carta and NewView partner, hoping to entice more startups to let employees sell shares early

items.content: <article>A new program wants to encourage more startups to allow workers to cash out early by making it easier to transact tender offers.</article>

items.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
items.author: TechCrunch Events
items.content: <article>Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.</article>

items.title: Agent cloud startup Daytona hits $1B valuation backed by FirstMark and a who’s who of angels
